item.title: [Message Center] MC1530948 Microsoft Purview | Information Protection: Auto-labeling support for legacy Microsoft Office file formats
item.description:
Microsoft Purview auto-labeling will support legacy Office files (.doc, .xls, .ppt) in SharePoint and OneDrive starting November 2026. Existing policies need a minor edit and rerun to include these formats. New policies support them automatically. This affects organizations using Purview auto-labeling for these platforms.

Microsoft 365 suite, Microsoft Purview · stayInformed

item.title: [New] Purview: legacy Teams retention policies stop governing Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions and become Teams-only; roadmap date moves from October 2026 to January 2027
item.description:
Copilot prompts and responses kept or deleted by a Teams policy today lose that coverage at conversion; retention, legal hold and eDiscovery answers for Copilot change without a new policy decision.

Purview · List the Teams retention policies whose scope covers Copilot interactions and create an explicit Copilot policy before January 2027.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Endpoint DLP protection for files in commonly excluded Windows folders (Temp, AppData) slips again, from December 2026 to February 2027
item.description:
Sensitive files staged in Temp or AppData stay outside Endpoint DLP until February 2027 at the earliest, a known gap for exfiltration through local staging folders.

Purview · Keep compensating detections for archive and copy activity in Temp and AppData on DLP-scoped devices until the feature ships.

item.title: [New] Auto-expanding archive mailboxes can grow to 3 TB instead of 1.5 TB for eligible licences (GCC, GCC High and DoD, mid-November to early December)
item.description:
Larger archives mean larger eDiscovery and content-search scopes during an investigation; storage is not a security control but it changes how long a search over a held mailbox takes.

Purview · Awareness only; update eDiscovery runbooks that assume a 1.5 TB ceiling.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Message Center] MC1521615 Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management increases the auto-expanding archive limit from 1.5 TB to 3 TB
item.description:
Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management increases the auto-expanding archive limit for eligible Exchange Online mailboxes from 1.5 TB to 3 TB, starting mid-November 2026. No additional configuration or charges are required; organizations should review licenses and monitor mailbox growth accordingly.
